comments: The checker runs axe-core 4.14 (open source, MPL 2.0) in headless Chrome on our server in the EU. German results use the official axe-core German locale. Nothing is stored; results are kept in memory for at most 10 minutes.
features: Free online checker that loads a public web page in a real browser (headless Chrome, with CSS and JavaScript) and tests it with axe-core against more than 60 WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA rules, including colour contrast. Results in German or English with code examples, WCAG success criteria and EN 301 549 clauses. No sign-up.
title: Rhein Code WCAG Check
